author: agent
scope: Original generic fine pebble-dash material, visually informed by a reference photograph. Colour, grain size and relief are estimates, not measurements of Ba Jin house.
periodic_method: Jittered pebble centres on a torus; every ellipse deposit wraps modulo512; matrix smoothing and height derivatives use wrapped neighbours. Pixel-centre rows0and511 need not be identical: their adjacency is an ordinary one-pixel toroidal step, not a duplicated gutter.
normal_height_scope: The encoded height gradients are attenuated by normalScale0.35 at render time. This is a conservative shading choice, not displacement geometry or a measured surface relief.

uv_contract.raw_gltf: For a vertical facade: U=local horizontal metres/0.40; V=-height metres/0.40. Keep unbounded UVs and REPEAT, with no per-part normalization, modulo or atlas-cell clamping.
uv_contract.png_rows: Top-to-bottom row index increases with stored PNG V.
uv_contract.current_no_tangent_web_frame: Three derivative frame follows raw+U right, raw+V down, outward normal. Frozen GLTFLoader negates normalScale.y when TANGENT is absent; effective scale is[+0.35,-0.35].
uv_contract.standard_blender_import: Importer converts V to1-V and keeps the green channel; its upward bitangent gives the same physical bump. Do not manually invert G or add another V flip.
uv_contract.physical_interpretation: On the left flank of a raised pebble the normal leans left; on the upper flank it leans up. These signs must be checked on the final renderer, not inferred merely from a normal map thumbnail.
uv_contract.if_explicit_tangents_added: Re-audit the actual tangent frame and loader behavior. The current tested contract is for primitives without TANGENT.
